# Board.org

> Board.org is a vendor-free peer community platform connecting enterprise leaders across specialized boards for unbiased strategic insights and peer-driven decision-making.

Board.org operates exclusive peer networks organized by industry and function, enabling confidential conversations among leaders in areas like data strategy, supply chain, talent marketing, DEI, and emerging technologies. The platform emphasizes vendor-neutral insights and peer-to-peer knowledge sharing for enterprise decision-makers.

## Peer Communities & Boards

- [All Communities](https://board.org/communities): Directory of all Board.org exclusive communities and peer networks
- [AEO Board](https://board.org/aeo): AEO Board: vendor-free community for answer engine leaders
- [Data Privacy Board](https://board.org/dataprivacy): Data Privacy Board: confidential community for privacy leaders
- [DEI Board](https://board.org/dei): DEI Board: peer network for diversity, equity, inclusion leaders
- [Employee Experience Board](https://board.org/employee-experience-peer-network): Employee Experience Board: peer network for EX and engagement leaders
- [Enterprise Data Strategy Board](https://board.org/data): Data Board: vendor-free community for enterprise data leaders
- [ESG & CSR Board](https://board.org/esg-csr): ESG & CSR Board: peer community for sustainability leaders
- [Learning & Development Board](https://board.org/learning-development): L&D Board: peer network for learning and development leaders
- [Manufacturing Board](https://board.org/manufacturing): Manufacturing Board: peer insights for manufacturing leaders
- [Supply Chain Board](https://board.org/supplychain): Supply Chain Board: vendor-free community for supply chain leaders
- [Talent Marketing Board](https://board.org/talent): Talent Marketing Board: peer community for employer brand leaders
